div.head: Iud Dei VIII 2.3
div.ab: Forðan we ðe þonne geornlice biddaþ, Drihten hælend Crist, þæt ðu gedó her swilc tácn, gyf ðes man scyldig sy, þæt ðis wæter hine ne onfó.
Deshalb bitten wir dich nun innig, Herr Heiland Christus, dass, wenn dieser Mensch schuldig ist, du hier folgendes Zeichen thun mögest: dass dies Wasser ihn nicht aufnehme.
Therefore we now earnestly pray you, Lord Saviour Christ, that, if this man is guilty, you may give here this sign: that this water does not receive him.
Therefore, we now sincerely ask you, Lord Saviour Christ, that if this man is guilty, you would perform the following sign here: that this water may not receive him.
div.note: Liebermann refers to the original of 2.3 f. at Iud Dei VII 24 f.
